audience: a parent or patient-group leader without medical training

sentences.text: The juvenile form of metachromatic leukodystrophy and combined PSAP deficiency are both linked to the gene PSAP in curated databases [e_b2d7ac18f1b8] [e_b52346f0801b].
Constellate computed that they share this causal gene, with confidence 0.95, the lowest of the two gene links [e_80448fe78f02].
The juvenile form is also linked to the gene ARSA in curated databases [e_a7fe160fd817].
ARSA and PSAP both take part in the same curated pathway, glycosphingolipid catabolism [e_6331a370f2a1] [e_8f8f3574e614].
Two features of the juvenile form are listed, impaired breakdown of a fatty substance and reduced activity of the enzyme arylsulfatase A in white blood cells [e_1261dddea3ea] [e_fc2694619ad6].
Both are curated with a low confidence of 0.5 [e_1261dddea3ea] [e_fc2694619ad6].
The only funding listed for combined PSAP deficiency is a grant titled about detectors for small animal imaging, so it may not be about this disease [e_1dcc3789df64].
These edges list no studies and no symptoms for combined PSAP deficiency [e_b52346f0801b].
